annotation.title_clean: Responsible AI in Social Protection and Welfare Systems in Africa
annotation.title_en: Responsible AI in Social Protection and Welfare Systems in Africa
annotation.authors_or_issuer: AUDA-NEPAD / African Union High-Level Panel on Emerging Technologies (APET)
annotation.venue: AUDA-NEPAD / APET Emerging Technology Governance Series
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Voluntary African Union (AUDA-NEPAD/APET) sector guidelines on responsible AI in social protection and welfare systems. Sets nine principles and recommended measures for Member States, including mandatory human review of eligibility decisions, fairness audits, DPIAs, redress, and capacity building. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Nine principles: seven cross-cutting plus proportionality/do-no-harm and dynamic inclusion
AI should not make final eligibility, suspension or sanction decisions; mandatory human review
Fairness audits, DPIAs and independent audits for high-stakes AI
Right not to be subject to wholly automated decisions, with redress mechanisms
Regulatory sandboxes, AI literacy and institutional oversight; voluntary adoption by Member States
